title: Payment Arrangements Servicing Desk — Restructure Balance Following a Recent Re-aging Deferral
content:
The amount re-spread by a restructure of a plan under Payment Arrangements — the restructure balance — follows deferrals on the plan.

## Rule

1. When the plan recorded a re-aging deferral in the last month and no debit falls due in the next 3 days, that is on or after the handling date and no more than 3 days after it, the restructure balance is the arrangement balance less the re-aged remainder, the re-aged installment keeping its own place behind the last restructured installment.
2. When the plan recorded a re-aging deferral in the last month and a debit falls due in the next 3 days, that debit is collected at the amount in force and the restructure balance is the arrangement balance less the re-aged remainder and less one regular installment.
3. Otherwise the restructure balance is the whole arrangement balance.

The re-aged remainder is the re-aged installment's regular amount less the installment payments applied to it and not returned, never less than zero. The re-aged installment is the installment named on the plan's most recent deferral entry; a re-aging deferral "in the last month" is a deferral entry on the plan's installment history recorded within one month back from the handling date. The debit that falls due next is the one at the plan's schedule anchor date; it falls in the next 3 days when that date is the handling date or up to 3 calendar days after it.

## Decision table

| Deferral entry in the last month | Next debit due within 0 to 3 days of the handling date | Restructure balance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Arrangement balance less the re-aged remainder |
| Yes | Yes | Arrangement balance less the re-aged remainder less one regular installment |
| No | Either | The whole arrangement balance |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: arrangement balance 1800.00, regular installment 200.00)

A deferral entry recorded 10 days ago names installment 6; 60.00 was paid to installment 6 and nothing returned, so the re-aged remainder is 140.00.

- Next debit due in 8 days: 1800.00 less 140.00 is 1660.00.
- Next debit due in 3 days: still within the 3 days — 1800.00 less 140.00 less 200.00 is 1460.00.
- Next debit due in 4 days: outside the 3 days — 1660.00.
- No deferral entry in the last month: 1800.00.
